predeclared_contract.scope: Four own static text roles in PersonalHomeEditor: title, Layout, Favorite apps, privacy disclosure; two settled openings per device. Separate current white capabilities title positivecontrol.
predeclared_contract.region_rule: Native literal static-text AX bounds, two logical points of outside ring, scale from app frame/screenshot dimensions. No fitted per-pixel masks or post-fix ROI tuning.
predeclared_contract.color_rule: Convert embedded ICC to sRGB when present; preserve profile hash, otherwise explicit screenshot sRGB assumption. Per-region maximum possible contrast <4.5 proves failure. PASS requires >=99% uniform modal-ring background, >=100 pixels of modal contrasting glyph-core color (most frequent color with contrast>=1.5), core/background ratio>=4.5. Native white capabilities header must pass same analysis.
predeclared_contract.roundtrip_rule: Native viewport before first opening and after second dismissal must have identical decoded RGBA pixels. No layout/favorite selection changes; captured values/labels retained, same profile Alex, Mockthermostat68.
predeclared_contract.limits: Narrow static-text screenshot estimate, not full accessibility/WCAG/physical-display/original-pixel pass. No real personal provider, Home, playback, capture or accounts.
